commit_subject: vendor: restore kimi deepseek2 sota path
objective: restore Kimi K2 SOTA support on the merged DeepSeek/Kimi vendor branch while preserving DeepSeek behavior

source_fixes.summary: Allow Kimi K2 GGUFs that report arch=deepseek2 and have a Kimi model name to keep deferred expert tensors on CPU while applying GPU layers.
Restore Kimi K2 top-k expert selection for the deepseek2 384-expert single-group layout without changing ordinary DeepSeek2 grouped routing.
Keep Kimi K2 YaRN yarn_log_multiplier semantics at the stored 0.1000 value while preserving the DeepSeek2 conversion-factor correction for non-Kimi models.
Fix batched MMVQ to pass the per-active-expert device pointer d_src0_row instead of the base pointer d_src0.

failed_before_fix.reason: deferred expert GPU override did not apply to Kimi K2 arch=deepseek2, causing a 385415.44 MiB CUDA allocation attempt
batched MMVQ used the wrong expert pointer; YaRN/top-k/defer fixes alone were insufficient

kimi_validation.decision: Kimi correctness, 16GB RAM, TTFT, deferred expert loading, YaRN semantics, and SOTA-shaped expert-pack counters are restored. The pushed-state repeat is in the prior accepted 1.36 tok/s band but did not reproduce the fastest 1.38 tok/s run on this host; the remaining delta is dominated by iouring_wait_us variance.

deepseek_validation.prior_merge_probe_status: DeepSeek strict cold run passed correctness/RAM/TTFT constraints at the merge checkpoint, but was below the accepted 4.4 tok/s SOTA.

current_host_asset_audit.available_models: Only Kimi-K2.7-Code-GGUF-IQ3_S was found under /root/lfz/models on the validation host.

deepseek_validation.reason_not_run: The validation host lacks the DeepSeek GGUF and accepted gate expert pack required by the strict DeepSeek SOTA runner.
deepseek_validation.preservation_scope: The Kimi-specific graph/model changes are guarded by Kimi model name or by the Kimi K2 384-expert single-group layout. Ordinary DeepSeek2 grouped routing and the non-Kimi YaRN correction remain on the merged DeepSeek path. The MMVQ pointer fix is a correctness fix for batched expert rows.
